source.note: tests/ and spikes/ are recorded because they define the accepted acceptance evidence; behavior identity is carried by sim/. tests/test_baseline_manifest.py checks that HEAD trees match, so any engine drift fails deterministically and requires a new candidate identity.

environment.local_reproduction: python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -> 65 passed on Windows-10, Python 3.11.9, NumPy 2.4.6, 2026-10-30
environment.claim_limit: Same-build, same-environment reproduction only; no cross-build bit-identity claim (see ADR-D0-01 and S23).

schemas.log: 0.1-legacy: gzipped jsonl, truncated kind hash, generic payload digest

schemas.state: 0.1-legacy: canonical_hash over sorted record columns and selected arrays, float64 ids, native endian; excludes pool order, id allocation, driver flags

model_claim_scope: BUILD0 micro-slice: prescribed cooling, finite thermal populations, effective weak conversion and nucleon formation, bounded nuclear network, aggregate capture, logging, same-build replay, restricted quiet-cell jumps. Calibrated effective model, not derived physics. See spec/status.json for the current status record distinguishing accepted slice, known defects, proposed contracts and unvalidated changes.

known_defects.summary: EventContext.draws restarts at (cell<<24)+(sub<<48); different species/requests reuse prefixes at the same tick/kind/cell/sub
network._rates skips pairs with absent forward reactant, so product-only states have no reverse dissociation edge
Fully captured species and T>T_GATE states have no reverse ionization path; 100-neutral diagnostic records zero events
jump_quiet compares per-tick weights against 1e-8 with JUMP_SPAN 1000; accumulated omitted hazard is unbounded

artifacts.role: preserved 0.1 acceptance run summary (seed 42, 8 cells, 3400 ticks, probe cells 2,3; final_hash fe8e094a9753b27c89fc0dffd1905f8de4be45263158d5712618ddd5f6ded1a0)
independent audit diagnostics backing the known_defects entries
archived 0.1 source snapshot for isolated historical execution

reproduction.policy: Hash validation of the preserved evidence requires no re-run of the universe. Historical 0.1 execution belongs to the archived source environment at the baseline commit; the current tree matches it until the first behavior change (ADR-D0-01).
